decisions.Hiroshima status: Accept existing operations as confirmed by the October 1 operator notice to continuing Hiroshima data-center customers. Explicit continuity of preexisting contracts and September demonstration corroborate current service. No opening date, completion date or renewable option before April 2027 inferred.
decisions.Hiroshima identity and geometry: The OSM data-center node links the exact former EneWings service URL, whose captured redirect leads to the current Hiroshima DC page. Operator housing terms page 36 explicitly connect the names. Source node [132.4758742,34.4005909] lies in the named Enecom Hiroshima Building ring; operator company page names its ICT Center there at Futabanosato 3-5-1, separately from HQ and 3-5-7 office. Accept labelled community-mapped named-property point with unknown measured accuracy.
decisions.Langfang status: Accept existing operation as of September 14 from the original China Securities Journal report attributing already commissioned racks to named participant Wen Yuan. Exact interview and opening dates unknown. Exclude three-building 315 MW expansion status and capacity.
decisions.Langfang identity and geometry: Original procurement notice section 1.5 gives the physical generator-testing service location at Louzhuang Road 100; original Securities Times site visit places the named data center there. ODCC bridges facility/corporate names. OSM way 697624944 names the exact branch; its source bounding-box midpoint [116.71704,39.6021711] is inside. Primary road spelling 楼庄 and OSM 娄庄 remain explicit. Marker is the named parent campus, not building geometry or surveyed extent.
decisions.Canonical evidence: Reuse the baseline CS URL, hash, id and canonical metadata exactly; extend only project association, with Langfang participant statement scoped in the new projection. Hiroshima has no canonical collisions.
decisions.Distinctness: Independent screens cover all 418 sites, 444 projects and 231 consolidated source records. Langfang is distinct from Boda, Haoyang and Tianjin Unicom; Hiroshima has no prior match.
decisions.Publication: Future-only Release inventory activates at this never-published sixteenth dataset. Every earlier local download URL remains available; current/latest remains local. Full asset verification precedes Pages deployment.
